Removed the one-time reboot-resilience backfill sweep (`minds-admin server backfill-autostart` and its `slices/autostart_backfill.py` module) now that the fleet-wide rollout completed at minds-v0.3.17 (188/188 VMs verified). The module embedded a verbatim copy of default-workspace-template's autostart installer that had to be kept in sync by hand; shedding it removes that drift liability. Per-VM recovery is now a manual re-apply of the template's installer block, documented in minds' `docs/deploy/reboot-resilience-rollout.md`.
